title: A shrinking relative band of heterogeneous profiled Gaussian mixtures retains coefficient h_g^prof

relative_band.hypothesis: For the K1572 profile S_N^*, assume (1-epsilon_N)S_N^*<=S_z<=(1+epsilon_N)S_N^* and Cov(m_z)<=eta_N S_N^*, with 0<=epsilon_N<1.
relative_band.trace_scale: Because omega_k/s_(N,k)=sqrt(omega_k^2+kappa_(g,N)^+) over Theta(N^3) cutoff modes, Tr[Omega(S_N^*)^(-1)]=O_g(N^4).
relative_band.energy_lower: K1572 bounds every stationary diagonal Gaussian component below by lambda_N^prof, while potential linearity and q_0=I_Omega/4 give Q_N(nu)>=lambda_N^prof-Delta/4.
relative_band.coefficient: The class contains the profile itself. If epsilon_N+eta_N->0, then inf Q_N(nu)/N^4->h_g^prof.
relative_band.scope_guard: This closes a shrinking relative band with arbitrary-mode translations. Fixed order-one heterogeneity, non-Gaussian components, phases, spatial textures and nonstationary laws remain open.
